title: Standard class: marks with a MAX row
how: Upload or paste, press Analyse class
expected: Teaching plan, gap map and reports appear. Weakest topics (Equilibrium, Chemical bonding) are marked 'Reteach to whole class'.

title: Percentages without a MAX row
expected: Note 'No MAX row found, so values were read as percentages.' Rotational motion is the weakest.

title: Cells copied from Excel as '45%' (tab-separated)
how: Open in Excel, copy all, paste into the box
expected: Accepted (fixed in v0.6 — previously every cell was rejected).

title: Negative marking, incl. Unicode minus (−) and en dash (–)
expected: Accepted. Negative scores count as 0% for percentages; gap map shows 0 for them.

title: Absent written as blank, AB, absent, -, NA, n/a
expected: All read as absent ('—' in the gap map), not as zero.

title: European CSV: semicolons and decimal commas
expected: 7,5 read as 7.5.

title: UTF-8 BOM, commas and quotes inside topic names
expected: Topic names: 'Work, energy & power' and 'Say "hi" topic' appear intact.

title: Hindi (Devanagari) and accented names
how: Analyse, then Create student report links and open one
expected: Names display correctly in the gap map and inside each student's report link.

title: Excel CSV with empty trailing columns and an empty row
expected: Accepted (fixed in v0.6 — previously 'Topic name is empty').

title: 'Class average' and 'Highest' rows at the bottom
expected: Notice: 'Skipped 2 summary rows … not counted as students' (fixed in v0.6 — previously counted as students).

title: Cells written as 15/20
expected: 15/20 read as 15 marks (75%).

title: Windows line endings (CRLF)
expected: Accepted.

title: A topic nobody attempted
expected: Optics shows 'No data' (not a 0% learning gap) and is listed last in the plan.

title: Smallest possible class
expected: Works; Algebra is 'Reteach to whole class' (1 of 1 below 50%).

title: Exactly at the limits: 500 students × 40 topics
how: Upload, analyse; note how long it takes
expected: Analyses in a few seconds; page stays responsive.

title: Maximum-marks row labelled “Full marks:”
expected: Row 2 is used as maximum marks (not a student). 3 students analysed; R2 Algebra = 50%.

title: MAX row at the bottom instead of row 2
expected: Analysis runs but a warning says the MAX row isn't under the header, so values are read as percentages, and tells you to move it to row 2.

title: Some rows have no roll number
expected: Analysis runs; a warning says 2 rows were named “Student …” by position and asks for roll numbers.

title: 40 long Hindi topic names (largest possible report link)
how: Upload, analyse, create links, open a Preview
expected: All 3 links are created and each one opens (links are ~13,000 characters; earlier builds rejected them as too long).

title: Score above the maximum
expected: Error naming row 3, column 2. Nothing analysed.

title: Text where a number should be
expected: Errors for both cells with guidance.

title: Same roll number twice (different case)
expected: Error on row 3.

title: Same topic twice
expected: Error on the header.

title: Header row forgotten (first row is marks)
expected: Error asking for a header row (fixed in v0.6 — previously 45 and 60 became topic names).

title: First student is called 'Max'

expect.issue: was read as the maximum marks

expected: Error explains row 2 was read as maximum marks and to rename it.

title: 41 topics (limit 40)
expected: Error.

title: 501 students (limit 500)
expected: Error.

title: Blank topic name between filled ones
expected: Error on header column 3.

title: MAX row with 0 and text

expect.issue: Maximum marks must be a plain number above 0

expected: Two errors on row 2.

title: Follow-up: first test
how: Analyse this first, then 'Compare with a follow-up test' and upload file 31
expected: See file 31.

title: Follow-up: retest with renamed/new topic, new and missing students, different capitals
how: Upload as the follow-up after file 30
expected: 4 students matched (R05 and R06 not compared); Statistics/Probability listed as not compared; 3 gaps closed (Algebra: R01, R04; Geometry: R03); 1 slipped (Geometry: R04).

title: Hex, exponent and space-inside-number cells
expected: Errors for 0x10, 1e3 and “1 5” — none is silently turned into 16, 1000 or 15. Plus “+5” and “7,5” are accepted.

title: Percentage and fraction cells above full marks
expected: “120%” and “25/20” are each reported as more than 100% (no misleading advice about MAX rows).

title: Tracker: test 1 of 3 for one class
how: Create a class, then '+ Add a test' with each file in order (dates 1 Jul, 1 Aug, 1 Sep)
expected: Add the next file.

title: Tracker: test 2 of 3 for one class
how: Create a class, then '+ Add a test' with each file in order (dates 1 Jul, 1 Aug, 1 Sep)
expected: Add the next file.

title: Tracker: test 3 of 3 for one class
how: Create a class, then '+ Add a test' with each file in order (dates 1 Jul, 1 Aug, 1 Sep)
expected: After all three: K01 Algebra '3×' and K03 Geometry (2 tests — absent in test 2, which is skipped, not counted as recovery); Mensuration appears from test 3 only.

title: Spreadsheet formula injection in roll numbers
how: Analyse, download reteach groups CSV and student links CSV, open them in Excel
expected: Excel shows the text (prefixed with ') — no formula runs, no link is created.

title: HTML / script in names
how: Analyse, open a student report link, print reports
expected: Shown as plain text everywhere; no alert box ever appears.

title: Web address used as a roll number
how: Analyse, then Create student report links
expected: Links created for R2 only, with a notice that 1 student was left out (fixed in v0.6 — prevents phishing text on heramb.study).
